description: Alterations to the Coach House to support rationalisation of the use as a training academy with 15 rooms of overnight accommodation, new teaching space and ancillary office space, comprising reconfiguration of approved west wing extension (refs: P2370.07 and L0018.07 dated 22 July 2009) and new enclosure of courtyard in lightweight glazed construction, restoration of original stable window openings in the front (south) elevation, removal of modern dormer and demolition of former scout hut and storage lean-to structures, replacement of windows, restoration of west chimney stack and internal alterations to restore heritage features.
decision_conditions: The development to which this consent relates must be commenced not later than three years from the date of this consent.
Reason:-
To comply with the requirements of Section 18(1) of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
Reason:-
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, a detailed schedule of works and method statement for all proposed internal and external works (including repairs to the windows of the listed building) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: Insufficient information has been supplied with the application to judge the appropriateness of the schedule of works and method statement for all proposed internal and external works (including repairs to the windows of the listed building).  Submission of this information prior to commencement will preserve the character and significance of the heritage asset and its setting.

Internal works shall not be commenced until a schedule of all new internal surface materials and finishes including walls, ceilings and floors and a schedule of all internal and external joinery  indicating the proposed finish and decoration to be used, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Works shall be implemented in
accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.

Reason: Insufficient information has been supplied with the application to judge the appropriateness of the internal surface materials and finishes including walls, ceilings and floors and a schedule of all internal and external joinery indicating the proposed finish and decoration to be used.  Submission of this information prior to internal works will ensure that the significance and fabric of the heritage asset are properly understood and safeguarded during the implementation of the development.

Prior to commencement of the external works, a schedule with details and clear photographs of the types and colour of the materials and finishes to be used in the external finishes (including photographs shown alongside the existing brickwork and roof tiles where applicable) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: Insufficient information has been supplied with the application to judge the appropriateness of the materials and finishes to be used in the external finishes. Submission of this information prior to commencement of the external works will preserve the character and significance of the heritage asset and its setting.

Details of proposed new windows, doors and glazed partitions to be used by section and elevation at scales between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to their first installation or construction on site. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be
permanently maintained as such.

Reason: Insufficient information has been supplied with the application to judge the appropriateness of the new windows, doors and glazed partitions to be used.  Submission of additional drawings that show details of proposed new windows, doors and glazed partitions to be used prior to their first installation or construction on site will preserve the character and significance of the heritage asset and its setting.

Detailed elevation drawings for reinstatement of the chimney at a scale of between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the external works. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.
Reason: To preserve the character and significance of the heritage asset and its setting.
Existing uPVC rainwater goods shall be replaced in cast iron and all new rainwater goods shall be black painted metal unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To preserve the character and significance of the heritage asset and its setting.

Statement Required by Article 35(2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management) Order 2015: No significant problems were identified during the consideration of the application, and therefore it has been determined in accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
